verdict.rationale: Ollama is a model runner with an API and a desktop app, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions Ollama itself connecting to MCP servers or consuming their tools. The listed integrations (Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, VS Code) are external agents that use Ollama as a model backend, which is adjacent and does not show Ollama plugging in MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
